title: runstate v0.3 value convention
description: Pins only the WRAPPER of the `value` topic (log format 0.4.0; docs/specs/commits-and-lineage.md section 3). Body {value, t}: `step` is removed; t stays nullable (absolute wall-clock seconds, or null if unstamped). The envelope `name` is required and non-null (the stream or source) and the envelope `request_id` is null: a value never names a subscription, a node's `fired` does. The `value` payload is arbitrary JSON. Applied on top of the envelope schema. No prose-only constraints.
